insurer_note: GA Life (GA Life Assurance Limited, subsidiary of GA Insurance, launched June 2013). The GA Life product index page lists only two individual products (Personal Pension Plan, Personal Provident Plan); the rest of the listing is group (pension, provident, group life, group credit life), which is out of scope. No individual term, whole-life, endowment or education products were found on the pages fetched. Entry age, term and minimum contribution not published on either page.

products.name: Personal Pension Plan
products.summary: Individual retirement scheme under an irrevocable trust (RBA/KRA registered) with 100% capital guarantee and 4% minimum guaranteed return; 1/3 cash and 2/3 monthly pension at retirement.
products.target_client: Employed individuals and their employers, self-employed individuals, SMEs/groups
products.how_it_works: Contributions invested under Section 50 of the Insurance Act and earn income from the day received; payroll deduction for employees, regular amounts for self-employed.
key_features: Guaranteed minimum return 4% on investment income
Monthly fund statement by the 10th; annual statement
Transfers in from other occupational or individual schemes
benefits: Employee contributions up to KShs 20,000/month not subject to PAYE
Death: 100% of both contributions plus interest to beneficiary (less taxes)
Incapacity/ill-health retirement: full fund paid (less taxes)
At retirement 1/3 cash, 2/3 lifetime monthly pension
products.term_or_duration: Not stated; earliest retirement age 50 (set by law)
products.min_premium_or_sum_assured: Not stated; PAYE exemption cap KShs 20,000/month
products.payment_options: Payroll deduction (fixed % or amount); regular self-employed contributions; application form or online
analysis_selling_points: Capital guarantee plus 4% floor appeals to risk-averse savers
Open to self-employed and SMEs, with transfers in
analysis_watch_outs: Entry age, minimum contribution and fees not published
Only 4% guaranteed floor; declared historical rates not shown
Employer contributions locked until age 50; 2/3 must become annuity pension

products.name: Personal Provident Plan
products.summary: Individual provident (lump-sum) retirement scheme for self-employed and others topping up retirement benefits; 100% capital guarantee, 4% minimum return, 100% of fund as cash at retirement.
products.target_client: Self-employed people and others supplementing retirement benefits; employed individuals and employers, SMEs/groups
products.how_it_works: Contributions invested under Section 50 of the Insurance Act, earning income from receipt; salary deduction or regular self-chosen contributions.
key_features: Monthly fund statement by the 10th; annual statement
benefits: Salary contributions up to KShs 20,000/month not subject to PAYE (page example: KShs 5,000 on KShs 50,000 salary)
Death: both contributions plus interest paid to nominee (less taxes)
Early retirement from 50 and retirement: 100% of fund as cash (less taxes)
Leaving job: own contributions plus interest paid in cash; employer portion locked to 50
products.payment_options: Salary deduction; regular self-chosen contributions; application form (ID, PIN, signature copies)
analysis_selling_points: Full lump sum at retirement, no compulsory annuity (per page)
Simple onboarding with soft copies of documents
analysis_watch_outs: Entry age, term, minimum contribution not published
Tax treatment of lump sum 'less taxes' not detailed
